cannot_check_rules: Any exact source file, licence, schema or canonical population hash mismatch.
Any review lacks both selected-label classes when first opened by the independent custodian.
Any selected label value cannot be mapped without semantic inference.
Any review is deleted, replaced, pooled, or post-outcome filtered.
Any label, seed, ordering or candidate/comparator outcome was opened before all protocol and implementation hashes were signed by the independent custodian.

label_adapter.current_access: HEADER_NAME_ONLY; NO ROW VALUE OR CLASS COUNT OPENED
label_adapter.rule: Use the selected column only after transfer to the independent protected custodian. Map source-declared truth values to binary inclusion under a separately signed schema receipt; any unmapped value or absent class makes the complete V6 identity CANNOT_CHECK.

outcome_boundary: NO LABEL VALUES, CLASS COUNTS, SEEDS, ORDERINGS, OR COMPARATIVE OUTCOMES ACCESSED

overlap_boundary.pmid_overlap_interpretation: Vacuous for KIFMS because all 5,074 pubmed_id cells are empty; content-identity disjointness is the operative external and cross-review gate.

population_rule.content_identity: SHA-256(case-sensitive whitespace-normalized title + one ASCII space + abstract)
population_rule.cross_review: exclude every row whose content identity or nonempty PMID occurs in more than one KIFMS review
population_rule.external: exclude on either content or PMID match to raw SWIFT or V5 work bodies
population_rule.within_review: exclude empty text; stable ascending key then source row; retain first unique content and nonempty PMID

selection_rule: Retain all fourteen CSV review files exposed by OSF node vt3n4 at exact file revision one. No review selection, deletion or replacement is permitted after this freeze.

source_identity.osf_title: Medical Guidelines Dutch Association Medical Specialists
